segments.note: 'So when we're using Opus,' (cut on silence; words.json runs ~0.25 s late here)

Opus 5.5 alone: 3:37 and $0.47.
Opus 5.5 + 10 Haiku 5.5 subagents: 0:58 and $0.14.
Let Opus think and coordinate. Let Haiku do the cheap, high-volume work. Just tell Opus to fan out subagents and make them Haiku.

reels.title: /voice: stop typing to Claude
